packforge.config.title: PackForge Settings
packforge.config.empty: No configurable options are available for this Minecraft version.
packforge.config.button.reset_all.toolti: Reset every available setting to its default value
packforge.config.apply.resource_reload: Applies on the next resource reload
packforge.config.option.reload_optimizer: Master switch for PackForge resource-pack reload optimizations. Child settings remain saved while it is off.
packforge.config.option.loader_index.des: Build per-pack resource indexes for faster resource and namespace lookups.
Use bounded parallel ZIP handles for resource reads. Disabled by default until benchmarked for a pack.
packforge.config.option.loading_status_o: Show the current resource reload phase on the Mojang loading overlay.
packforge.config.option.loading_fade_out: Remove the Mojang loading overlay immediately after a completed reload.
packforge.config.option.reload_summary_t: Show the total resource-pack reload time in a toast after completion.
packforge.config.option.font_provider_se: Move CPU-only font provider selection away from render-thread apply work.
packforge.config.option.font_bitmap_cach: Cache bitmap font providers when their resource fingerprint is unchanged.
packforge.config.option.model_parse_batc: Batch block-model parsing to reduce executor overhead on large packs.
Number of block-model JSON files parsed in each worker task.
packforge.config.option.model_parse_timi: Log model list, read, parse, and collection timings for diagnostics.
packforge.config.option.model_adaptive_b: Adjust the model parse batch size from the number of resources being loaded.
packforge.config.option.model_duplicate_: Reuse exact duplicate immutable model JSON parses within one reload.
packforge.config.option.loader_timings.d: Log PackForge resource index counters and timings for diagnostics.
packforge.config.option.reload_listener_: Log a resource reload summary and listener timing CSV rows.
packforge.config.option.shader_stall_dia: Identify long Shader Loader render-thread stalls after resource reloads.
packforge.config.option.immediatelyfast_: Avoid re-enabling incompatible font atlas resizing during pack removal reloads.
packforge.config.option.font_reload_diag: Log font provider counts and detailed font timing information.
packforge.config.option.atlas_phase_timi: Log atlas source, decode, stitch, mipmap, and upload timings.
packforge.config.option.atlas_decode_bat: Batch sprite decoding work to reduce executor overhead.
Number of sprite source loaders processed in each decode task.
packforge.config.option.large_atlas_fixe: Master switch for atlas overflow and atlas-related resource-pack compatibility fixes.
packforge.config.option.model_uv_clamp.d: Prevent invalid tiny negative UV coordinates from crashing translucency checks.
packforge.config.option.atlas_cap.descri: Cap oversized sprite frames before stitching to prevent atlas overflow.
packforge.config.option.atlas_cap_pixels: Maximum sprite frame dimension when the atlas cap is enabled.
packforge.config.option.atlas_exclude_id: Comma-separated atlas IDs that should never have their sprites capped.
packforge.config.option.atlas_retry.desc: Retry atlas construction with recovery safeguards after an overflow.
packforge.config.option.atlas_retry_atte: Maximum number of recovery attempts for one atlas.
packforge.config.option.atlas_retry_disa: Disable atlas retry when a shader pipeline is present unless explicitly overridden.
packforge.config.option.atlas_mip_parall: Generate atlas mipmaps in bounded worker batches.
packforge.config.option.atlas_mip_batch_: Number of sprites processed in each mipmap worker batch.
packforge.config.option.startup_optimize: Master switch for PackForge startup and initialization optimizations.
Log startup optimizer timing events and CSV rows.
packforge.config.option.startup_status_o: Show the current startup optimizer phase on the loading screen.
packforge.config.option.startup_executor: Tune Minecraft background worker count and priority during startup.
packforge.config.option.startup_worker_t: Number of background startup workers. Use 0 for automatic selection.
packforge.config.option.startup_thread_p: Priority assigned to tuned Minecraft startup workers.
packforge.config.option.startup_skip_smo: Leave executor behavior unchanged when a Smooth Boot variant is installed.
packforge.config.option.startup_async_da: Enable reload-safe asynchronous model JSON batching and duplicate parsing cache.
packforge.config.option.startup_async_cl: Collect mod-jar class scan telemetry without changing loader entrypoint order.
packforge.config.option.startup_async_fo: Enable CPU-only asynchronous font selection, atlas decoding, and mipmap preparation.
